mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% indicate deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0%, or the correlation between UNRATE > 5.0% and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust aggregate demand and supply chain activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both increase, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points per month signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the correlation between the rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (index 2017=100) indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO > 105.0, or the correlation between INDPRO > 105.0 and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market strengthening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 (thousands of units) reflect strong residential construction demand, signaling economic expansion and positive corporate earnings growth, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with HOUST > 1400, or the correlation between HOUST > 1400 and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) immediately reduces equity cost of capital, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
